children: Flash-storage manufacturer Sandisk (SNDK, Financials) is getting some love after Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy kicked off coverage with a Buy rating and a $2,400 price target.

As AI models become more complex and inference workloads generate more data, artificial intelligence is creating a larger opportunity for NAND flash, Cassidy says. It might broaden NAND's significance beyond traditional demand from cellphones, PCs and consumer gadgets.
The analyst also points to Sandisk's technology roadmap, including BiCS8 and BiCS10 systems, which are aimed to boost storage density while controlling costs.

Customer agreements with Sandisk may give additional source of help. The business has secured New Business Model agreements with eight of its largest NAND clients, which Cassidy thinks may account for nearly 65% of fiscal 2028 production.
Those deals could provide Sandisk with improved foresight into future demand and help smooth some of the volatility that has long been a feature of the NAND market.
The company also established a longer-term goal of mid-to-high teens sales growth and around 80% non-GAAP gross margins, the article said.
The next driver will be seeing if AI-driven storage demand translates into greater NAND prices, manufacturing commitments and Sandisk revenue growth.

title: Sandisk Just Got a Major Vote of Confidence From Wall Street
